Mehak Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 September,
2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Jbp:42642
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Jabalpur

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pramod Kumar Agrawal

On The 4 th Of September, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 38247 of 2025
 Mehak Yadav
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Parvez Ahmed Quazi - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Manoj Kumar Singh - Panel Lawyer for the responden

Order 
This is the first application under Section 483 of B.N.S.S. for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.50/2025 registered at Police Station Ashoka Garden, District Bhopal (M.P.) for offence punishable under Section 370, 372, 376/109, 16/17, 318-4, 338, 336-3 of IPC.

entities.text: Police Station Ashoka Garden, District Bhopal
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The applicant is in custody since 24.01.2025.
2.
As per the prosecution story, the applicant and co-accused persons have involved in the business of prostitution.
They have indulged the prosecutrix into the said business.
Thereafter, they have solemnized the marriage of prosecutrix with one person on the basis of forged Aadhar Card.
Therefore, the offence has been registered against the present applicant and co-accused persons under the aforesaid section.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
He is in custody since 24.01.2025.
It is submitted that the only allegation against present applicant is that she used to trade the prosecutrix from one place to another place.
The applicant has delivered a child in April, 2025 in jail.
At present, she has two minor children.
The conclusion of trial NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:42642 2 MCRC-38247-2025 will take considerable time.
In these circumstances, applicant may be granted bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant and has submitted that the applicant is the wife of main accused Ashutosh Bajpayee.
One mobile and Rs.800/- has also been seized from present applicant.
The forged documents of prosecutrix in which her name is mentioned as Aarti Sharma have also been seized from present applicant.
On the basis of those documents, she solemnized marriage of prosecutrix with one person Vinod Jain.

sentences.text:
The applicant has also criminal antecedents of four cases which are registered at Crime No.969/2023 & 146/2024 in P.S. Shahpura, Bhopal, Crime No.323/2024 in P.S. Misrond, Bhopal &
Crime No.39/2023 in P.S. Ashoka Garden, Bhopal.
Hence, the applicant does not deserve grant of bail.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
6.
Looking to aforesaid facts and circumstances as well as act of present applicant and seriousness of the offence, I am not inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
7. Accordingly, present MCRC stands dismissed.
